preregistered.observable: per block and iteration, a = (samples with exactly one click in the block's slot that land on an algebra mode) / (samples with exactly one click in the slot), the observable of scripts/qd_packed_mode_swap_analysis.py
preregistered.order: per block set, the iterations alternate the layouts, packed first for an even block set and swapped first for an odd one; each layout runs its primary seed at its first and last slot and its replicate seeds between them, one for set 0 and three for sets 1 to 4, whose mean slot is the pair's mean slot; sets 1 to 4 run their first five and last five iterations as two consecutive jobs, so a primary pair straddles the gap between them; the within-set validity statistic measures the drift between the repeats and its kappa^2 scales the binomial variances of the placement test; a drift step between a set's two jobs and a linear drift both add to the mesh spread, so they raise sigma_c^2 rather than lower it
preregistered.binding: a result iteration binds to its setting by circuit_params and compilation_seed; the two primary repeats of one layout share both and bind in returned order; an iteration that returns no counts holds its slot
preregistered.analysis: --analyze pools the runs of job-00 (set 0) and job-03 to job-10 (sets 1 to 4) into one table over all 30 blocks; every statistic below is withheld unless all 30 blocks are complete, meaning each of the iterations of their set returned counts in exactly one run
preregistered.mesh_identity: the sha256 of each returned computed_circuit; the two primary repeats of a layout request one mesh, and a pair with different or missing digests drops out of the validity statistic, its block-layout contrasts drop out of the mesh variance and its blocks drop out of the placement test; the reading is withheld unless every replicate digest differs from its primary digest and from the other replicate digests of its layout
preregistered.validity: per block set, per block and layout, z = (a_repeat1 - a_repeat0) / two-sample se of the primary repeats; D = sum z^2 over the set's mesh-identical pairs against chi-square with that many degrees of freedom, drift detected when p < 0.01; a set with no mesh-identical pair withholds the placement reading. D checks that the within-set contrast is internally valid and carries no statement about the earlier hour-scale drift. kappa^2 = max(1, D / dof) of the set scales the binomial variances of that set's blocks in the placement test
preregistered.mesh_variance: per block and layout, the m meshes are the pooled primary repeats and each replicate; their shares a_i have sample variance s^2 on m - 1 degrees of freedom with expectation sigma_c^2 + mean binomial variance, c the block's class: half (p_algebra 1/2) or extreme (p_algebra 0 or 1); sigma_c^2 = max(0, sum (m - 1)(s^2 - mean variance) / sum (m - 1)) over the class's groups is the per-seed mesh variance of a in that class, withheld when the class keeps fewer than 10 degrees of freedom; its one-sided 0.95 upper bound is max(0, sum (m - 1) s^2 / chi2.ppf(alpha, dof) - sum (m - 1) mean variance / dof)
preregistered.slot_homogeneity: per physical slot, S = sum (m - 1) s^2 / (sigma_c^2 + mean variance) over the groups the slot holds against chi-square with their summed degrees of freedom; one mesh scale per class holds unless some slot has p < 0.01 / 6
preregistered.placement: per block, delta = mean over the swapped meshes of a - mean over the packed meshes of a, which under no placement effect has variance sigma_c^2 (1 / m_swapped + 1 / m_packed) plus the kappa^2 binomial variances of each mesh divided by its layout's m squared; z = delta / sqrt(that); a block moved beyond the mesh variance when |z| > 4.5; the placement lies beyond the mesh variance when at least 2 blocks do and the slot homogeneity holds; blocks moved against binomial error alone are those of decide() in scripts/qd_packed_mode_swap_analysis.py on the pooled table
preregistered.slot_predictor: decide() on the pooled packed and swapped table of all iterations of each layout, reported with the slot predictor's r and Fisher 95 percent interval as a descriptive statistic: ten of its fourteen half-block predictions include the block's own swap partner, so it carries no reading
preregistered.comparison: per block, delta_new = a_swapped - a_packed of the pooled table against delta_old of the retained qpu_belenos box_kite_photonic_packed and box_kite_photonic_packed_swapped series; reproduce when Pearson r has a lower bound above 0.3 and the blocks of equal sign beat one half with a one-sided exact binomial p < 0.01; uncorrelated when r has a lower bound at or below 0.3 and an upper bound below 0.7; indeterminate otherwise
preregistered.earlier_excess: X(w) = sum over the 30 blocks of delta_old^2 / (2 w sigma_c^2 upper bound + binomial variance of delta_old) against the 0.99 quantile q of chi-square on 30 degrees of freedom; an uncorrelated comparison reads mesh when X(1) <= q, excess when X(3) > q, and window otherwise

reading_table.none / any: no moves: the earlier separation fails
reading_table.beyond / reproduce: moves beyond the mesh variance reproduce the earlier deltas: not hour-scale drift
reading_table.beyond / indeterminate: moves beyond the mesh variance with the earlier deltas neither reproduced nor excluded: inconclusive
reading_table.within / reproduce: moves not shown beyond the mesh variance reproduce the earlier deltas: not hour-scale drift, placement per block unresolved
reading_table.within / indeterminate: moves not shown beyond the mesh variance with the earlier deltas neither reproduced nor excluded: inconclusive
reading_table.beyond / uncorrelated-mesh: moves beyond the mesh variance do not follow the earlier deltas, which stay within the per-seed mesh variance: the earlier deltas read as mesh error
reading_table.beyond / uncorrelated-window: moves beyond the mesh variance do not follow the earlier deltas, which exceed the per-seed mesh variance only within a threefold window change: the source of the earlier deltas is unresolved
reading_table.beyond / uncorrelated-excess: moves beyond the mesh variance do not follow the earlier deltas, which exceed the per-seed mesh variance even at a threefold window change: the earlier deltas read as hour-scale drift or unseeded compilation
reading_table.within / uncorrelated-mesh: moves not shown beyond the mesh variance do not follow the earlier deltas, which stay within the per-seed mesh variance: the earlier deltas read as mesh error
reading_table.within / uncorrelated-window: moves not shown beyond the mesh variance do not follow the earlier deltas, which exceed the per-seed mesh variance only within a threefold window change: the source of the earlier deltas is unresolved
reading_table.within / uncorrelated-excess: moves not shown beyond the mesh variance do not follow the earlier deltas, which exceed the per-seed mesh variance even at a threefold window change: the earlier deltas read as hour-scale drift or unseeded compilation

preregistered.interpretation: The design shows whether moving a packed block changes its algebra-mode share by more than that share varies between compiled meshes of one layout, and whether the per-block changes reproduce the changes of the earlier separate jobs. Reproduction rules out hour-scale drift as their source. When the changes do not follow the earlier deltas, the size of the earlier deltas against the measured per-seed mesh variance reads them as mesh error, as hour-scale drift or unseeded compilation, or as unresolved within a threefold change of the mesh variance between acquisition windows. The slot predictor is descriptive. The design does not show how a chip mode changes a share.
